entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

U testigo yami Dios nyi tachi did u nae trichi di y di adorar.
Atestiguo di nami ama impotencia did ama poder, u pobre u tedy riqueza. Utá ama Dios amanté didn did ayudar nae ama peligro, chi ama nuy yi idiñas.
